items.en_title: How to Build and Host a Custom Discord Bot Without Writing Boilerplate
items.en_oneliner: Skip the repetitive scaffolding and quickly build a custom Discord bot for your game community, with ticket panels, welcome embeds, and reaction roles.

items.en_title: How to Create Custom 16x16–128x128 Minecraft Resource Packs with AI
items.en_oneliner: Generate style-consistent pixel textures in bulk with AI and skip the hours of pixel-by-pixel hand drawing for a custom resource pack.

items.title: Dedicated server or VDS? A practical way to decide for databases, game servers and CI
items.en_title: Dedicated server or VDS? A practical way to decide for databases, game servers and CI
items.en_oneliner: Starting from real symptoms like CPU wobble and latency spikes, this guide helps you decide whether your game server needs a dedicated box or a VDS with pinned cores.

items.title: This Manga-Style Action FPS Uses Radial Gravity to Turn Walls into Floors
items.en_title: This Manga-Style Action FPS Uses Radial Gravity to Turn Walls into Floors
items.en_oneliner: Developer sembask explains how the Godot game's spherical world pulls players toward its shell, turning walls into walkable floors.

items.title: From 2D to 3D and back to 2D again, the original platforming classic Super Meat Boy returns with a slick remaster complete with new levels and too many old saws
items.en_title: From 2D to 3D and back to 2D again, the original platforming classic Super Meat Boy returns with a slick remaster complete with new levels and too many old saws
items.en_oneliner: After this year's 3D detour, the original returns in a remaster with updated visuals and new levels — a useful gauge of how a classic re-release is put together.

items.title: Can AI Build a 500-Enemy Horde in Godot?
items.en_title: Can AI Build a 500-Enemy Horde in Godot?
items.en_oneliner: One prompt to Claude Opus 5.5: build a 500-enemy horde in Godot that always reaches the player and never gets stuck, graded against a scorecard written before the first pass.

items.title: Can AI Solve Godot's Stairs Problem?
items.en_title: Can AI Solve Godot's Stairs Problem?
items.en_oneliner: Claude Opus 5.5 takes on a Godot first-person controller that must climb stairs and slopes like a shipped game, tested on a course of twelve lanes, steps and drops.

items.title: Building a Custom HTML5 Canvas + Synced Video Engine for Real-Time Combat Dialogue (V.E.T.O.R — A Ruptura)
items.en_title: Building a Custom HTML5 Canvas + Synced Video Engine for Real-Time Combat Dialogue (V.E.T.O.R — A Ruptura)
items.en_oneliner: This Brazilian indie action-adventure skips Unity, Unreal and Godot for a custom HTML5 Canvas engine layered over synced MP4 scenes, with real-time companion dialogue and multilingual voice switching in combat.

items.title: Showing players what a crime can drop, and fixing our notifications (Movetio devlog #5)
items.en_title: Showing players what a crime can drop, and fixing our notifications (Movetio devlog #5)
items.en_oneliner: This update skips big features for trust: crime results now show the loot you got, job cards preview drop chances, and notifications stop flickering or opening the wrong page.

items.title: How to get and use Cargo in ROB RUN
items.en_title: How to get and use Cargo in ROB RUN
items.en_oneliner: A player-facing Destructoid guide on how to get and use cargo in ROB RUN, mostly skippable for developers.

items.title: Game MVP Development: What to Build First and Why
items.en_title: Game MVP Development: What to Build First and Why
items.en_oneliner: This guide breaks down what a game MVP should include — one polished core loop, 20 to 30 minutes of content, and basic progression — to test whether players will come back with minimal cost.

items.title: Do you like mob tagging in oldschool MMOs, or are you done with fighting for quest credit?
items.en_title: Do you like mob tagging in oldschool MMOs, or are you done with fighting for quest credit?
items.en_oneliner: PC Gamer asks whether mob tagging in old-school MMOs is a nostalgic part of the genre or a design that should have been left behind.

items.en_title: Missed something on your first go around The Blood of Dawnwalker? I've got good news, as next week's update adds in new game plus

items.en_title: Humble Fumbles & November GameDev Deals Round-Up
items.en_oneliner: A round-up of November deals and bundles for game developers, including the Unity Asset Store low-poly mega bundle — a good moment to stock up on tools and art assets at a discount.

items.en_title: Show DEV: I built GitHub Multiverse — a Decentraland-style 3D virtual world where devs walk as 3D mouse cursors
items.en_oneliner: Built from scratch with Three.js and Node.js, this 3D collaborative virtual world for developers lets participants walk around as 3D mouse cursors.

items.en_title: Gravity Forge — a browser game in one folder

items.en_oneliner: A clear breakdown of what's inside an .osk file and how to package an osu! skin correctly, whether you're building skin tools or sharing an edited skin with a friend.

items.title: Echo Warden: Fight beside your past selves
items.en_title: Echo Warden: Fight beside your past selves

items.title: Humble Bundle's Redesign Lost 2FA. Every Migration Plan Should Learn From It
